title: Arizona water evidence for defensible industrial growth
question: Which records show whether industrial growth has defensible water capacity?
why_it_matters: Industrial strategy in a water-constrained region depends on water rights, provider capacity, reuse, treatment, discharge, drought exposure, and public legitimacy.
current_support: FTFN has ADWR water governance and assured-supply criteria plus Phoenix Water Services' April 2026 provider-level update on supply sources, drought posture, and planned reliability investments.
missing_evidence: provider service capacity for named industrial sites
candidate_records: next City of Phoenix Water Resource Plan
industrial water service or infrastructure agreement
facility water demand, discharge, or reuse disclosure
next_action: Add a named industrial service, facility-demand, discharge, or reuse record before making facility-level water claims.
notes: Phase 51 added a named municipal provider record. The gap remains open because provider-level portfolio and drought planning do not prove capacity or service terms for a named industrial project.
